library_preparation_preflight.summary: micronaut-data-runtime is the shared runtime for Micronaut Data. It has no data backend of its own and its repository interceptors need a DataOperations bean. Meaningful coverage therefore needs a backend (JDBC + in-memory H2), the Micronaut test extension, and compile-time annotation processors, none of which the default scaffold provides. This mirrors the existing tests/src/io.micronaut.data/micronaut-data-jdbc/5.1.3 project. No Docker image is needed because H2 runs in memory.

deterministic_setup.reason: Provides a JDBC DataOperations backend, so the runtime's repository interceptors and query execution paths can run. Same version as the library under test.
Datasource wiring for the JDBC backend. Version taken from the existing micronaut-data-jdbc test.
In-memory database, so no Docker image is required. Version taken from the existing micronaut-data-jdbc test.
Provides @MicronautTest and injection into JUnit tests. Version taken from the existing micronaut-data-jdbc test.
Assertions, as in the existing Micronaut Data test.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Add annotation processors to build.gradle, which the deterministic setup cannot express: testAnnotationProcessor "io.micronaut:micronaut-inject-java:5.1.10" and testAnnotationProcessor "io.micronaut.data:micronaut-data-processor:$libraryVersion". Without them, @JdbcRepository interfaces and @MappedEntity classes are not generated, and the test fails at runtime. Copy the layout of tests/src/io.micronaut.data/micronaut-data-jdbc/5.1.3: a @MicronautTest(startApplication = false, transactional = false) class with @Property values datasources.default.url=jdbc:h2:mem:<name>;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1, driver-class-name=org.h2.Driver, username=sa, empty password, schema-generate=CREATE_DROP and dialect=H2. Exercise runtime classes through @JdbcRepository CrudRepository and PageableRepository interfaces: CRUD, pagination and sorting, derived finders, @Version optimistic locking, and transactions. Set the user-code-filter.json rules to exclude everything, then include io.micronaut.data.** and the test package, and set the conditional agent mode in build.gradle as the existing project does. Do not touch metadata/io.micronaut.data unless native-image runs report missing entries.
risks: The existing micronaut-data-jdbc 5.1.3 project already covers much of the runtime through the same backend. The new project may show heavy overlap, or shipped metadata may collide with that library's entries.
Native image may hit the tracing Class[] overflow with junit and micronaut-test. Keep test types simple.
The 5.1.3 runtime pins specific Micronaut core versions (inject-java 5.1.10). Mismatched processor and runtime versions can break bean generation.
